webkit.scope: Actual browser editing and downloads on disposable WordPress. Customer renderer HTTPS transport is substituted with a fixture using real Fullbleed PDF bytes. No production network, email delivery or branded Safari claim.

visualReview.result: Inspected default, visually edited and customer PDF pages: headings, addresses, items and totals fit without overlap or clipping for these synthetic fixtures. WebKit account actions were inspected at desktop and 390px widths.

limitations: Playwright Firefox and WebKit are automation distributions. WebKit is not branded Safari; Safari, macOS, iOS and physical mobile devices were not tested.

The browser matrix uses disposable WordPress Playground/PHP WASM stores with HPOS. The separate native WordPress free-plugin job passes on Chrome only. Existing HPOS/legacy backend checks are separate from browser coverage.
Customer renderer HTTPS transport is a test filter returning actual Fullbleed PDF bytes. This is not a production renderer, email delivery or continuous availability claim.
A 390px viewport check does not establish full mobile editor usability or all theme/browser/merchant template combinations.
PDF preview bytes and native downloads are checked. Embedded PDF-viewer rendering is browser-dependent and was not asserted in headless WebKit.
Paid purchase, update delivery, merchant pilots and marketplace approval remain open. Runtime ZIPs and the prerelease status are unchanged.
